topArchetypes.name: Thanos Fractured Frontier
topArchetypes.description: Still the defining card of the ladder in early September: per the Aug 31 marvelsnapzone Ranked Meta Tier List snapshot (Fractured Frontier Week 4), 9 of the top 10 archetypes clearing 50%+ win rate in Infinite rank ran Thanos Fractured Frontier, with several builds reported above 60%. Neither the Aug 27 OTA nor the AXIS: Inversion season launch touched the card, so it carries over unchanged into the new season.

topArchetypes.name: Ongoing Affliction / High Evolutionary
topArchetypes.description: The lone non-Thanos archetype in that same top-10 list. Hellcow: Fractured Frontier enabled a second High Evolutionary build (discounting Abomination via Affliction) alongside the traditional shell, which sharply increased the value of Luke Cage as the primary tech answer to both this and Thanos Fractured Frontier.

topArchetypes.name: Self-Destruct Deadpool (Destroy)
topArchetypes.description: Deadpool's regenerate-with-double-power-on-destroy loop, fed by Carnage/Venom/Killmonger/Deathlok/Knull, is independently listed as a current top deck by community guides; one card-tracking source places the Destroy archetype at Tier A overall.
